_notes: Copy this file to config.json in the same folder, then edit.
Only processes listed here are watched - there is no auto-discovery.
pattern = bracket-style regex matched against process args in the ps table.
The bracket style ('[w]orker-a.py') keeps the pattern from matching the
watchdog's own command line. restart_command = argv list (never a shell
string), or null = monitor-only (death is reported, never restarted).
The second entry below is a monitor-only example.
